d:
Peja Stojakovic was UNSTOPPABLE when Yugoslavia needed him the most!
Facing Spain in the EuroBasket 2001 semifinals, Stojakovic delivered an absolute MASTERCLASS, pouring in 30 POINTS to lead Yugoslavia to a 78-65 victory!
From his incredible shooting touch to his scoring ability, Peja showed exactly why he was one of the most dangerous players in European basketball! A HUGE performance on the biggest stage, sending Yugoslavia straight to the FINAL!
Relive Peja Stojakovic's INCREDIBLE semifinal performance!
